bugs.title: The fifteenth reset loses its delay on the next tick
bugs.detail: Grounded O at native (3,38), wait100ms,15 alternating successful Right/Left moves. After move15 lockTime=0 and no stored minos; tick(1) writes4 instead of granting500ms. Fourteen-reset control passes499/500ms. Both Chromium key paths agree.

bugs.title: A clicked Sound button captures Space instead of hard drop
bugs.detail: During play mouse-click Sound (#audio), then actual Space. At desktop and390x844, sound toggles false→true while stored cells4, score28 and active O(4,-1) stay unchanged. Expected hard drop and unchanged sound. The focused-visible-button key guard returns and Sound retains focus.

scores_and_findings.summary: Complete tested scoring and hidden lock-out; fifteenth-reset and focused-Sound Space minors

bugs.title: The fifteenth grounded reset locks immediately
bugs.detail: Grounded O at native (2,38), contact established, wait100ms,15 alternating successful Right/Left moves. Move15 immediately stores4 minos and spawns the next piece instead of granting500ms. Fourteen-reset control passes499/500ms. updateContact locks at lockMoves>=15; its own test expects that early lock. Actual keys agree in both Chromium sizes.
